decision.author: gemini-antigravity
decision.rationale: R3 corrects the stale pre-relaxation KKT acceptance check, conditions checkpoint serialization on several physical gates, and appropriately treats the damping spectrum as a hypothesis. However, one material acceptance defect remains in the supplied driver. After the final mechanical consistency solve, max_consistency_delta_u is calculated and printed but never tested against the declared 1e-9 mm tolerance or included in physical_pass. The history is also recomputed from the final displacement without checking its change against the 1e-4 MPa coupled-history tolerance. Consequently, the driver can serialize converged_checkpoint_01.json with physical_acceptance=PASS even when the final mechanical correction materially changes the displacement or history, so the accepted fields have not been demonstrated to satisfy the coupled convergence criteria together. The supplied consistency regression test uses illustrative arrays rather than exercising this actual checkpoint decision path. Before execution approval, enforce final mechanical displacement consistency <=1e-9 mm, final history consistency <=1e-4 MPa, and final-state KKT and physical gates jointly; suppress checkpoint commitment otherwise. Add driver-level failure-path tests demonstrating that excessive final corrections prohibit acceptance. Preserve the frozen UEL, donor reference, 100-iteration budget and all other criteria. Submit the corrected hash-bound candidate for independent re-review. Do not submit the currently reviewed R3 package.
